name: Grand Prix 4-Season

origin.basis: German tire maker; Continental lists the tire on its global bicycle site.

manufacturing.basis: Continental says the tire is handmade but the pages read do not state the factory country.

positioning: Continental's handmade all-season training and racing clincher with a double Vectran breaker and DuraSkin sidewalls.
protection: Double Vectran breaker and DuraSkin sidewalls
weight_basis: Performance Bicycle listing weights; Continental's current page gives no size table.

wet_notes.summary: Continental positions it for training and racing 'come rain or shine'; no independent wet test recorded.

availability.note: Back-ordered at a US retailer on 2026-11-01; Continental's current page lists the tire without sizes; other regions not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Retail listing price for the 25 mm option on 2026-11-01; back order; one tire.

caveats: Sizes and weights come from a retailer listing catalogued since 2018, not from Continental's current page; the listing shows the 25 mm lighter than the 23 mm.
The retailer gives inflation figures without calling them maximum pressures.
Neither page calls it tubeless-ready, and Continental names its tubeless-ready versions 'TR'; it is recorded as a tube-type clincher.
Wet performance is a maker claim; no independent wet test recorded.

image.shown: Black Grand Prix 4-Season as pictured on Continental's product page; one picture covers every width.
image.alt: Continental Grand Prix 4-Season road tire with black sidewall and tread pattern

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.
